capabilities: Collect vault checkboxes with #kanban/ tags into a kanban board
Move cards between customizable columns via drag or menus
Show tasks on a month/week/day calendar view
Group cards into swimlanes and boards by project, client, priority or due date
Sync task completion and dates with Microsoft To Do and GitHub Projects
extras: Free plugin; development is supported through a Buy Me a Coffee link. The README has a privacy section stating there is no telemetry and listing exactly which services the plugin contacts. Large changelog in both English and Dutch is included in the README.
problem: Markdown checkboxes are scattered across vault notes with no board to view, move and track them together as tasks.

relations.evidence: Your Microsoft To Do tasks become cards.
connect one or more Microsoft/Outlook accounts via OAuth and see your appointments next to your tasks
Your GitHub Projects boards become cards.
and via Exchange they appear in Apple Reminders too
the five built-ins keep their emoji (Tasks-plugin compatible)

summary: Kanban board that collects tasks from every note in the vault as draggable cards, with due dates, projects, calendar view and optional Outlook sync.
